FILE: INTEGRATION_REQUEST.txt

STATUS: WIP
AGENT: agent3
BRANCH: codex/agent3

SUMMARY:
Reworking sheet-metal corner relief after senior review. Current direction is to stop patching local 3D relief cases and move toward a semantic runtime pipeline: resolved relief specs, explicit relief sites, developed-coordinate cutouts/charts, then 3D mapping.
First step is isolating corner relief normalization/resolution and site evaluation so renderer code no longer owns fallback dimensions or pseudo-vertex geometry decisions.
No project JSON mesh/vertex storage is being added. The JSON remains semantic: sketch, bends, relief type/dimensions/clearance.
Current iteration also removes the old circular sphere-projection path from the bend strip renderer and checks circular bend relief against developed-coordinate inset math.
Next runtime foundation is now present: sheet-metal charts for base/root bends/flanges plus circular relief cutouts defined once in developed coordinates. Tests verify the circular equation across base, bend, and flange charts, clearance as effective cutout radius, and the small-radius no-flange-intersection case.
Circular chart clipping now also produces runtime clipped boundaries and boundary edge metadata (`reliefSiteKey`, `cornerReliefRole`) for base, bend, and flange charts. Small-radius flange charts remain unmodified when the cutout does not intersect them.
Added a runtime chart-to-scene evaluator for root-bend circular corner reliefs. It maps clipped base/bend/flange chart domains to finite scene faces/lines, tessellates bend charts by developed `u`, carries stable relief boundary metadata onto side faces, and is wired behind `geometry.sheetMetalReliefEvaluator`.
Extended the developed-coordinate pipeline to rectangular reliefs. Rectangular width/depth/clearance now create cutouts across base, bend, and flange charts, keep effective dimensions explicit, and preserve relief boundary metadata on full-depth endpoint cuts.
Corner Relief properties now consume the model-layer resolved default spec through the panel object state, so the inspector shows the same effective dimensions and diagnostics as the semantic resolver without importing engine code from UI metadata.
Circular, rectangular, and obround relief chart cutouts now share a single runtime `buildReliefCutout2d(site, spec)` developed-coordinate profile. Base, bend, and flange chart cutouts are transformed from that profile, and the old duplicate circular/rectangular chart-specific cutout builders were removed from `relief-cutouts.mjs`.
The default viewer setting is now `charts-supported`, and supported bent plates now use chart geometry even when they do not have an active corner relief site. Unsupported no-relief bends may still use the legacy path during migration, while active reliefs that the selected chart mode cannot handle are reported instead of falling back silently.
Chart-evaluated relief side faces now carry both `cornerReliefSiteKey` and `cornerReliefVertexId`, so existing selection/properties routing can target the same sketch corner without relying on legacy side-face metadata. Chart front/back faces hide internal triangulation edges and expose only boundary lines, avoiding the selected-plate triangle overlay artifact.
Chart evaluation now validates clipped chart boundaries before mapping to 3D and validates emitted scene faces/lines afterward. Invalid developed domains, non-finite points, zero-area chart domains, degenerate faces, and zero-length chart lines are reported as diagnostics instead of silently disappearing.
Shared-boundary tests now run across circular, rectangular, obround, tear, and v-notch chart cutouts, checking that base-to-bend and bend-to-flange cutout endpoints agree in 3D. This exposed an obround base-profile mismatch; the obround base cut now uses a single smooth developed 2D curve from one flange edge endpoint to the other, with depth controlled along the corner bisector, so it remains triangulable and aligned with chart endpoints.
Chart-relief support checks now reject invalid developed chart domains before the scene adapter chooses the chart evaluator, and runtime tests cover circular relief over 30, 60, 90, and 135 degree bends in both up and down directions.
Corner relief spec resolution now treats invalid provided dimensions, such as negative radius or negative gap, as `status: invalid` with error diagnostics instead of silently converting them into normal fallback dimensions.
Chart-domain relief evaluation now propagates resolver diagnostics into the sheet-metal pipeline. Invalid/unsupported resolved relief specs no longer generate cutouts, and `chartReliefGeometrySupport()` rejects those plates before `charts-supported` can select the chart renderer.
Chart-domain validation now also detects self-intersecting developed boundaries before triangulation or 3D mapping, so malformed chart domains are rejected as unsupported instead of being passed into the scene renderer.
Base chart corner clipping now reports explicit warning diagnostics when a requested corner relief cutout is clamped by adjacent edge length, instead of silently changing the user's requested cutout radius/width/depth.
Relief cutout clipping now exposes the explicit runtime pipeline `buildPlateSheetCharts() -> evaluateCornerReliefSites() -> resolveReliefSpecsForSites() -> applyReliefCutoutsToCharts(chartResult, sites, specs, options)`, while the plate-level helper remains only a wrapper over those steps.
Corner Relief properties no longer include a private UI-side effective-dimension resolver. The inspector now uses model-layer resolved state for effective radius/width/depth/clearance and reports an explicit diagnostic if that resolved state is missing.
`charts-supported` now blocks legacy fallback when an active corner relief has chart-evaluation errors such as invalid dimensions, invalid developed domains, or conflicting bend-on-bend endpoint cutouts. Invalid active reliefs can no longer be rendered by the old heuristic path.
Clipped sheet charts now carry chart-local `cutoutApplications` copied from the developed relief cutouts. Bend chart scene generation consumes those chart-local applications instead of rediscovering endpoint cutouts from global evaluation state, keeping cutout metadata attached to the chart domain.
The data-model contract now explicitly states that stored corner relief `gap` resolves to cutout `clearance`, not bend endpoint trim. The resolver has the same inline contract, keeping the legacy JSON field name separate from the runtime meaning.
Legacy `plateBendGeometry` no longer adds corner relief `gap`/`clearance` into bend endpoint trimming. Root sketch-corner trim keeps only the thickness compensation used by the old path, while generated bend-corner reliefs no longer trim by `gap / 2`.
Sheet-metal charts now include runtime-only child bend and child flange charts derived from a parent flange chart for `parentEdge` start/end/outer. Simple bend-on-bend relief rendering uses the chart path, while conflicting bend-on-bend endpoint cutouts now block legacy fallback instead of being silently hidden.
Endpoint relief clipping now reports an error diagnostic when multiple corner relief cutouts target the same chart endpoint. This prevents bend-on-bend chart evaluation from silently overwriting one relief cutout with another through a `Map` and makes the remaining generated-corner ambiguity explicit.
Model-layer generated bend-corner reliefs now match the runtime relief-site evaluator: a child side bend on a parent flange creates one real generated corner at the bend intersection, not a second pseudo corner at the free flange end. Legacy tests were updated to assert one marker/one source-panel relief per side child bend.
Corner relief API objects now carry stable `siteKey` and structured `target` metadata for both sketch corners and generated bend-on-bend corners. The old `vertexId` remains for UI/override compatibility, but runtime/API consumers no longer have to treat generated bend corners as only fake sketch vertices.
Authoring bend previews are now marked as transient preview plates. If a preview bend creates a conflicting chart-relief endpoint, the preview geometry is skipped instead of throwing the whole scene or falling back to legacy `plateBendGeometry`; committed objects still raise the chart diagnostic.
Base-chart corner relief clipping now routes every non-circular cutout through the developed 2D cutout profile and clamps resulting relief boundary points in the local corner wedge. Oversized rectangular, obround, tear, and v-notch reliefs no longer pass raw profile points outside the adjacent base edges; they report the same explicit clamp diagnostics used for circular reliefs.
Bend/flange endpoint relief curves now clamp their inset to the owning chart length and attach chart-specific clamp diagnostics. Chart scene row generation uses the same clamped endpoint inset, so rendered bend faces cannot reintroduce out-of-range endpoint cuts after the cutout evaluator already clipped them.
Chart scene line emission now drops zero-length runtime lines instead of emitting invalid relief boundary artifacts. Added small-relief chart invariants for circular, rectangular, obround, tear, and v-notch cases so very small or skinny cutouts must remain finite and error-free.
Corner relief spec resolution now preserves explicitly provided zero dimensions instead of treating them as missing values. Manual `radius: 0` and zero rectangular dimensions resolve to zero/no-op cutouts, while omitted manual dimensions still get deterministic fallback warnings.
Chart relief support now validates the final chart-to-scene mapping through the same helper used by `evaluateBentPlateChartGeometry()`. A plate can no longer report `supported: true` if its clipped chart domains map to scene geometry with error diagnostics.
The scene adapter now defaults missing `geometry.sheetMetalReliefEvaluator` to `charts-supported` instead of `legacy`. Explicit `legacy` mode remains available for migration tests, but an active supported relief no longer falls back to legacy just because an entrypoint omitted the setting.
Chart relief runtime coverage now includes skewed sketch-corner angles around 60, 90, and 120 degrees across circular, rectangular, obround, tear, and v-notch reliefs. The shared-boundary invariant now checks the actual clipped base-chart relief boundary segments when available, instead of relying on sampled full-cutout points.
Bend chart scene generation now derives its row envelope from the chart's clipped developed boundary (`clippedBoundary2d`) instead of recomputing endpoint insets from relief profiles. This keeps rendered bend surfaces downstream of the single chart clipping result and removes another duplicate relief interpretation from the renderer.
Bend chart domain validation now rejects clipped developed boundaries that would produce multiple interior horizontal intervals before mapping to 3D. The bend renderer therefore cannot silently fill unsupported multi-interval cutouts while the full polygon-boolean migration is still incomplete.
Relief chart clipping now routes every chart through a single `clipChartDomainByCutouts()` entrypoint. The current base-corner and endpoint clipping implementations remain migration strategies, but every clipped chart now carries runtime-only `domainClip` metadata with the chart coordinate system, difference operation, strategy, and cutout counts.
Clipped chart domains now also carry a runtime-only `chartDomain2d` polygon-set object with `supportedTopology: "single-outer-loop"`. Chart scene generation and validation consume that domain object first, while legacy `clippedBoundary2d` and `boundaryEdges` remain compatibility mirrors during the polygon-boolean migration.
The actual single-loop clipping assembly now lives in `chart-domain.mjs` as `differenceSingleLoopChartDomain()`. Base corner and endpoint relief code only produce boundary replacement descriptors; they no longer build final clipped loops or relief edge metadata locally in `relief-cutouts.mjs`.
`buildPlateSheetCharts()` now attaches an identity `chartDomain2d` polygon-set to every base, bend, flange, child bend, and child flange chart as soon as the chart is created. Relief clipping now subtracts replacements from that existing chart domain, keeping the pipeline closer to `build charts -> subtract cutouts -> map domains to 3D`.
Relief cutouts now also carry explicit runtime-only `cutoutRegion2d` polygon-sets. The developed-site cutout produced by `buildReliefCutout2d()` exposes the intended 2D cut region, and each chart-local cutout/application exposes the same concept in `chart-2d` coordinates; the current single-loop boundary replacement remains a migration strategy, but cutouts are no longer represented only as replacement curves.
The default `charts-supported` renderer path no longer falls back to legacy `plateBendGeometry` after chart-domain evaluation reports an unsupported domain. Explicit `legacy` mode remains as a conscious migration/test mode, but default chart errors now stay visible even for malformed bent plates without an active corner relief site.
Chart scene generation now requires each sheet chart to carry an explicit runtime `chartDomain2d` polygon-set. It no longer reconstructs a compatibility domain from `clippedBoundary2d` or `domain2d` arrays, so missing chart domains are reported as chart-domain errors before 3D mapping.
Legacy `plateBendGeometry()` no longer contains the old corner relief evaluator. The relief outline sampler, 3D panel/sphere projection helpers, endpoint relief trim helpers, and generated-corner panel relief path were removed; `plateBendGeometry()` now returns plain bend targets/strips/panels with `cornerReliefs: []`, while all visible relief geometry must come from the sheet-metal chart evaluator.
Runtime source guards now fail if `plate-bend-geometry.mjs` reintroduces the old relief helper symbols such as `reliefAdjustedOutline2d`, `reliefCornerPoints`, `projectedReliefInsetAtBendOffset`, `projectedBendEndpointPoint`, or `cornerReliefEndpointTrim`.
Browser smoke check after removing legacy relief helpers: opened sheet-metal-corner-reliefs-1 on agent3 port 5183 with `qaSheetMetalReliefEvaluator=charts-supported` and selected circular relief; canvas rendered, Properties and Corner Relief remained visible, and console warning/error logs were empty.
Base chart relief clipping now subtracts the chart-local `cutoutRegion2d` produced by the developed relief pipeline directly. The old base-only relief resampling/clamping path was removed, so base, bend, and flange consume one cutout-region contract instead of separate interpretations.
Circular developed cutouts now force exact samples on the two adjacent sketch-edge directions. This keeps base/bend/flange shared relief endpoints aligned for non-90-degree sketch corners while still using tessellated developed 2D cutout regions.
Sketch-corner relief sites now carry adjacent edge limits, and the model resolver clamps oversized effective corner-relief dimensions with explicit `corner-relief.<dimension>.clamped-by-edge` diagnostics. Oversized rectangular, obround, tear, and v-notch cutouts are constrained before chart clipping, instead of relying on renderer-side base clipping hacks.
Senior-review export regenerated after the latest code changes: `C:\boberos\agent3\corner-relief-review-export.txt`.

Added runtime/source coverage that relief clipping uses `differenceSingleLoopChartDomain()` and that `relief-cutouts.mjs` does not reintroduce local boundary-node assembly. This also covers wrapped endpoint replacements preserving relief metadata on the closing edge.
Added runtime/source coverage that initial sheet charts expose `chartDomain2d` identity polygon-sets before relief clipping, and that those domains match the compatibility `domain2d` boundary arrays.
Added runtime/source coverage that developed and chart-local relief cutouts expose `cutoutRegion2d` polygon-sets with `purpose: "cutout"`, chart-local cutout applications preserve those regions, and chart domain clip metadata reports how many explicit cutout regions were available.
Added runtime/source coverage that `charts-supported` has no legacy fallback helper, and that a malformed chart-domain bent plate without an active relief site is blocked instead of being silently rendered by legacy geometry.
Added runtime/source coverage that `chart-scene-geometry.mjs` no longer contains the `legacy-boundary-array` fallback or imports `createSingleLoopChartDomain`, and that a chart missing `chartDomain2d` is rejected by chart-domain diagnostics.
Relief clipping now exposes `differenceSingleLoopChartDomainByCutoutRegions()` as the chart-domain contract. `relief-cutouts.mjs` no longer calls the boundary replacement helper directly or creates fallback chart domains from raw point arrays; the old boundary replacement strategy is isolated as the temporary backend behind explicit `cutout-region-difference` metadata.
Chart-domain clipping now derives its internal single-loop replacement from the chart-local `cutoutRegion2d` geometry itself. `relief-cutouts.mjs` no longer passes `boundaryReplacement` descriptors across the layer boundary; oversized base and endpoint cutouts clamp to a tiny positive chart margin so they remain finite instead of collapsing onto the outer chart boundary.
Clipped charts now expose `cutoutApplications` from the exact applied chart-local cutout regions used for domain difference. For base corner reliefs this keeps the original developed/chart source region as `sourceCutoutRegion2d`, while the renderer-facing `cutoutRegion2d` is the locally clamped bite region that actually produced the clipped chart boundary.
`chart-domain.mjs` no longer exposes or calls the old replacement-only `differenceSingleLoopChartDomain()` helper. The cutout-region difference now consumes chart-local polygon-set regions directly and emits `cutout-region-difference` / `simple-polygon-segment-graph` metadata without `boundary-replacement-difference`.
Chart-domain clipping now replaces the old interval/boundary-walk backend with a segment-graph 2D difference for supported single-loop chart domains: domain and cutout edges are split at intersections, domain subsegments inside the cutout are removed, cutout subsegments inside the domain are added in difference orientation, and the resulting graph is traced back into one chart boundary.
The old interval-walk helper code was removed from `chart-domain.mjs`, and runtime source guards now prevent `cutoutRegionIntervalFromGeometry`, `normalizedCutoutInterval`, `domainNodesBetween`, and the old `single-loop-region-boundary-walk` backend from returning as active chart-domain clipping code.
Relief boundary metadata is now attached from graph edges, not graph nodes, so short non-circular cutout segments retain `source: relief`, `reliefSiteKey`, and `cornerReliefRole` even when their endpoints touch domain segments.
Browser smoke check after the segment-graph backend: reloaded `sheet-metal-corner-reliefs-1` on agent3 port 5183 with selected circular relief; canvas rendered, Properties remained visible, and browser warning/error logs were empty.
Scene rendering now blocks explicit `sheetMetalReliefEvaluator: "legacy"` for bent plates with active corner relief sites. Legacy mode can still cover ordinary no-relief bend migration cases, but visible corner relief geometry must go through the chart-domain evaluator or report a chart diagnostic.
Runtime coverage now asserts that the sheet-metal corner relief demo fails if forced through legacy mode, while small-radius circular preview plates and generated bend-on-bend relief scenes render only chart-evaluated faces without `bendSurfaceStripFaceRole` legacy faces.
Browser smoke check: opened sheet-metal-corner-reliefs-1 on agent3 port 5183 with `qaSheetMetalReliefEvaluator=charts-supported` and selected rectangular relief; canvas rendered, UI stayed mounted, selected rectangular relief loaded, and console errors were empty.
Browser smoke check: opened sheet-metal-corner-reliefs-1 on agent3 port 5183 without `qaSheetMetalReliefEvaluator`; default `charts-supported` rendered selected circular relief, UI stayed mounted, Properties remained visible, and console errors were empty.

NOTES:
Senior-review export is available at C:\boberos\agent3\corner-relief-review-export.txt.
The scene renderer now has a default-on-for-supported chart-domain path for ordinary bent plates and circular, rectangular, obround, tear, and v-notch root-bend reliefs. Active corner reliefs are no longer allowed to render through explicit legacy scene mode. This is still not the final corner relief architecture: the new segment-graph backend handles supported single-loop boundary cutouts, but full polygon-set topology such as holes or multiple loops is still intentionally rejected with diagnostics before all old `plateBendGeometry` relief helper code can be removed.

FILE: bobercad/app/engine/api/project/plate-sketch/bend-normalization.mjs
====================================================================================================

import { finiteNonNegativeNumber, finiteNumber, finitePositiveNumber } from "../../../core/math.mjs";
import { uniqueTruthy } from "../../../core/model.mjs";
import { sketchEdges } from "./model-accessors.mjs";
import { fail, plainObject, sketchEdgeIsCircularArc } from "./sketch-geometry-and-relations.mjs";

const BEND_PARENT_EDGES = new Set(["outer", "start", "end"]);

export function normalizeBend(bend, sketch, bendIds = new Set()) {
  if (!plainObject(bend)) fail("bend must be an object");
  if (bend.relief !== undefined) fail("bend relief is not supported; use plate fabrication.reliefDefaults and fabrication.cornerReliefs");
  const edgeIds = new Set(sketchEdges(sketch).map((edge) => edge.id));
  const parentBendId = bend.parentBendId;
  if (parentBendId !== undefined && (typeof parentBendId !== "string" || !parentBendId)) fail("bend parentBendId must be a non-empty string");
  const edgeId = parentBendId ? null : bend.edgeId;
  if (typeof bend.id !== "string" || !bend.id) fail("bend id must be a non-empty string");
  if (parentBendId) {
    if (!bendIds.has(parentBendId)) fail(`bend references unknown parent bend ${parentBendId}`);
    if (parentBendId === bend.id) fail("bend cannot reference itself as parent");
    if (!BEND_PARENT_EDGES.has(bend.parentEdge)) fail("bend parentEdge must be outer, start, or end");
  } else if (!edgeIds.has(edgeId)) {
    fail(`bend references unknown sketch edge ${edgeId}`);
  } else if (sketchEdgeIsCircularArc(sketch, edgeId)) {
    fail(`bend edge ${edgeId} must be a straight sketch edge; curved bend edges are not supported yet`);
  }
  const angle = bend.angle;
  const radius = bend.radius;
  const kFactor = bend.kFactor;
  const flangeLength = bend.flangeLength;
  const gap = bend.gap;
  const startGap = bend.startGap;
  const endGap = bend.endGap;
  if (!finiteNumber(angle)) fail("bend angle must be a finite number");
  if (!finiteNonNegativeNumber(radius)) fail("bend radius must be zero or positive");
  if (kFactor !== undefined && (!finiteNumber(kFactor) || kFactor < 0 || kFactor > 1)) fail("bend kFactor must be between 0 and 1");
  if (!finitePositiveNumber(flangeLength)) fail("bend flangeLength must be positive");
  if (gap !== undefined && !finiteNonNegativeNumber(gap)) fail("bend gap must be zero or positive");
  if (startGap !== undefined && !finiteNonNegativeNumber(startGap)) fail("bend startGap must be zero or positive");
  if (endGap !== undefined && !finiteNonNegativeNumber(endGap)) fail("bend endGap must be zero or positive");
  if (bend.direction !== "up" && bend.direction !== "down") fail("bend direction must be up or down");
  return {
    id: bend.id,
    ...(parentBendId ? { parentBendId, parentEdge: bend.parentEdge } : { edgeId }),
    direction: bend.direction,
    angle,
    radius,
    ...(kFactor !== undefined ? { kFactor } : {}),
    ...(gap !== undefined ? { gap } : {}),
    ...(startGap !== undefined ? { startGap } : {}),
    ...(endGap !== undefined ? { endGap } : {}),
    flangeLength
  };
}

export function bendDescendantIds(bends, seedIds) {
  const removed = new Set(uniqueTruthy(seedIds));
  let changed = true;
  while (changed) {
    changed = false;
    for (const bend of bends) {
      if (!removed.has(bend.id) && removed.has(bend.parentBendId)) {
        removed.add(bend.id);
        changed = true;
      }
    }
  }
  return removed;
}


====================================================================================================
FILE: bobercad/app/engine/api/project/plate-sketch/bends.mjs
====================================================================================================

import { plateBends } from "./model-accessors.mjs";
import { bendDescendantIds, normalizeBend } from "./bend-normalization.mjs";
import { cleanPlateCornerReliefFabrication } from "./corner-reliefs.mjs";
import { normalizePlate } from "./model-and-placement.mjs";
import { fail, optionalObject } from "./sketch-geometry-and-relations.mjs";

export function upsertPlateBend(plate, bendPatch) {
  const sketch = plate.sketch;
  const existingIds = new Set();
  for (const bend of plateBends(plate)) {
    if (typeof bend?.id !== "string" || !bend.id.trim()) fail("bend id must be a non-empty string");
    if (existingIds.has(bend.id)) fail(`duplicate bend id ${bend.id}`);
    existingIds.add(bend.id);
  }
  if (bendPatch?.id !== undefined) existingIds.add(bendPatch.id);
  const bend = normalizeBend(bendPatch, sketch, existingIds);
  const sameTarget = (item) => {
    if (bend.parentBendId || item.parentBendId) {
      return item.parentBendId === bend.parentBendId && item.parentEdge === bend.parentEdge;
    }
    return item.edgeId === bend.edgeId;
  };
  const existingBends = plateBends(plate);
  const replacedIds = existingBends
    .filter((item) => item.id !== bend.id && sameTarget(item))
    .map((item) => item.id);
  const removedIds = bendDescendantIds(existingBends, replacedIds);
  const bends = existingBends.filter((item) => item.id !== bend.id && !removedIds.has(item.id));
  bends.push(bend);
  const fabrication = cleanPlateCornerReliefFabrication(plate, {
    ...optionalObject(plate.fabrication, {}, `${plate.id}.fabrication`),
    bends
  });
  return normalizePlate({
    ...plate,
    type: "bent-plate",
    fabrication
  });
}

export function removePlateBend(plate, bendId) {
  if (typeof bendId !== "string" || !bendId.trim()) fail("bend id must be a non-empty string");
  const existingBends = plateBends(plate);
  const seedIds = existingBends
    .filter((bend) => bend.id === bendId || bend.edgeId === bendId)
    .map((bend) => bend.id);
  if (!seedIds.length) fail(`${plate?.id || "plate"}: bend not found: ${bendId}`);
  const removedIds = bendDescendantIds(existingBends, seedIds);
  const bends = existingBends.filter((bend) => !removedIds.has(bend.id));
  const fabrication = cleanPlateCornerReliefFabrication(plate, {
    ...optionalObject(plate.fabrication, {}, `${plate.id}.fabrication`),
    bends
  });
  return normalizePlate({
    ...plate,
    type: bends.length ? "bent-plate" : "plate",
    fabrication
  });
}


====================================================================================================
FILE: bobercad/app/engine/api/project/plate-sketch/corner-reliefs.mjs

import { finiteNonNegativeNumber, finitePositiveNumber } from "../../../core/math.mjs";
import { arrayValues } from "../../../core/model.mjs";
import { plateBends, sketchVertices } from "./model-accessors.mjs";
import { fail, orderedSketchLoop, plainObject } from "./sketch-geometry-and-relations.mjs";

const CORNER_RELIEF_MODES = new Set(["auto", "manual"]);
const CORNER_RELIEF_TYPES = new Set(["none", "round", "circular", "rect", "rectangular", "obround", "tear", "v-notch"]);
const CANONICAL_CORNER_RELIEF_TYPES = new Set(["none", "circular", "rectangular", "obround", "tear", "v-notch"]);
const CHILD_CORNER_PARENT_EDGES = new Set(["start", "end"]);
const CORNER_RELIEF_CLAMP_MARGIN = 1e-4;

export const PLATE_CORNER_RELIEF_TYPES = Object.freeze([...CORNER_RELIEF_TYPES]);

export function canonicalPlateCornerReliefType(type = "circular") {
  if (type === "round") return "circular";
  if (type === "rect") return "rectangular";
  return CANONICAL_CORNER_RELIEF_TYPES.has(type) ? type : "circular";
}

function reliefRequestedDimensions(relief = {}) {
  return {
    ...(relief.radius !== undefined ? { radius: relief.radius } : {}),
    ...(relief.width !== undefined ? { width: relief.width } : {}),
    ...(relief.depth !== undefined ? { depth: relief.depth } : {}),
    ...(relief.gap !== undefined ? { gap: relief.gap } : {})
  };
}

function autoDimension(value, fallback, key, mode, diagnostics) {
  if (value !== undefined) {
    if (finiteNonNegativeNumber(value)) return value;
    return fallback;
  }
  if (mode === "manual") {
    diagnostics.push({
      code: `corner-relief.${key}.defaulted`,
      severity: "warning",
      message: `Manual corner relief ${key} is missing; using ${fallback}.`
    });
  }
  return fallback;
}

function clearanceFromRelief(relief = {}) {
  // Project JSON keeps the legacy field name `gap`; the resolved model
  // contract exposes it only as cutout clearance, never as bend endpoint trim.
  return finiteNonNegativeNumber(relief.gap) ? relief.gap : 0;
}

function finiteLimit(value) {
  return finitePositiveNumber(value) ? value : null;
}

function siteLimit(site, role, clearance = 0) {
  const rawLimit = role === "incoming"
    ? finiteLimit(site?.limits2d?.incoming)
    : role === "outgoing"
      ? finiteLimit(site?.limits2d?.outgoing)
      : finiteLimit(site?.limits2d?.corner);
  if (rawLimit === null) return null;
  return Math.max(0, rawLimit - Math.max(0, clearance || 0) - CORNER_RELIEF_CLAMP_MARGIN);
}

function clampResolvedDimension(value, key, limit, site, diagnostics) {
  if (!finiteNonNegativeNumber(value) || limit === null || value <= limit + 1e-7) return value;
  const effective = Math.max(0, limit);
  diagnostics.push({
    code: `corner-relief.${key}.clamped-by-edge`,
    severity: "warning",
    message: `Corner relief ${key} was clamped from ${value} to ${effective} by adjacent edge length.`,
    siteKey: site?.key || "",
    cornerReliefVertexId: site?.legacyVertexId || site?.target?.vertexId || "",
    requested: value,
    effective,
    limit
  });
  return effective;
}

function resolvedStatus(base, diagnostics) {
  if (base.status === "invalid" || base.status === "unsupported") return base.status;
  return diagnostics.some((diagnostic) => diagnostic.severity === "warning" && String(diagnostic.code || "").includes(".clamped-by-edge"))
    ? "clamped"
    : base.status;
}

function hasOwn(object, key) {
  return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(object || {}, key);
}

function invalidProvidedDimension(relief, key) {
  return hasOwn(relief, key) && relief[key] !== undefined && !finiteNonNegativeNumber(relief[key]);
}

function invalidReliefDimensionKeys(relief, type) {
  const keys = new Set(["gap", ...cornerReliefRequiredFields(type)]);
  if (type === "obround" && hasOwn(relief, "radius")) keys.add("radius");
  return [...keys].filter((key) => invalidProvidedDimension(relief, key));
}

function appendInvalidDimensionDiagnostics(relief, type, diagnostics) {
  const invalidKeys = invalidReliefDimensionKeys(relief, type);
  invalidKeys.forEach((key) => {
    diagnostics.push({
      code: `corner-relief.${key}.invalid`,
      severity: "error",
      message: `Corner relief ${key} must be zero or positive.`
    });
  });
  return invalidKeys;
}

export function cornerReliefRequiredFields(type = "circular") {
  switch (canonicalPlateCornerReliefType(type)) {
    case "none":
      return [];
    case "circular":
      return ["radius"];
    case "rectangular":
      return ["width", "depth"];
    case "obround":
      return ["width", "depth"];
    case "tear":
      return ["depth", "width"];
    case "v-notch":
      return ["depth", "width"];
    default:
      return [];
  }
}

export function resolvePlateCornerReliefSpec(relief, plate = {}, site = null) {
  const fallback = relief || defaultPlateCornerRelief(plate?.thickness);
  const mode = CORNER_RELIEF_MODES.has(fallback?.mode) ? fallback.mode : "auto";
  const type = canonicalPlateCornerReliefType(fallback?.type);
  const thickness = finitePositiveNumber(plate?.thickness) ? plate.thickness : 0;
  const clearance = type === "none" ? 0 : clearanceFromRelief(fallback);
  const diagnostics = [];
  const requested = reliefRequestedDimensions(fallback);
  const invalidDimensionKeys = type === "none" ? [] : appendInvalidDimensionDiagnostics(fallback, type, diagnostics);
  const base = {
    source: site?.source || "",
    mode,
    type,
    radius: null,
    width: null,
    depth: null,
    clearance,
    requested,
    status: invalidDimensionKeys.length ? "invalid" : "ok",
    diagnostics
  };
  if (type === "none") return base;
  if (type === "circular") {
    const requestedRadius = autoDimension(fallback?.radius, thickness * 2, "radius", mode, diagnostics);
    const radius = clampResolvedDimension(requestedRadius, "radius", siteLimit(site, "corner", clearance), site, diagnostics);
    return { ...base, status: resolvedStatus(base, diagnostics), radius };
  }
  if (type === "rectangular") {
    const requestedWidth = autoDimension(fallback?.width, thickness * 2, "width", mode, diagnostics);
    const requestedDepth = autoDimension(fallback?.depth, thickness * 2, "depth", mode, diagnostics);
    const width = clampResolvedDimension(requestedWidth, "width", siteLimit(site, "incoming", clearance), site, diagnostics);
    const depth = clampResolvedDimension(requestedDepth, "depth", siteLimit(site, "outgoing", clearance), site, diagnostics);
    return { ...base, status: resolvedStatus(base, diagnostics), width, depth };
  }
  if (type === "obround") {
    const widthFallback = finitePositiveNumber(fallback?.radius) ? fallback.radius * 2 : thickness * 2;
    const requestedWidth = autoDimension(fallback?.width, widthFallback, "width", mode, diagnostics);
    const requestedDepth = autoDimension(fallback?.depth, Math.max(requestedWidth, thickness * 3), "depth", mode, diagnostics);
    const width = clampResolvedDimension(requestedWidth, "width", siteLimit(site, "corner", clearance), site, diagnostics);
    const depth = clampResolvedDimension(requestedDepth, "depth", siteLimit(site, "corner", clearance), site, diagnostics);
    return { ...base, status: resolvedStatus(base, diagnostics), radius: width / 2, width, depth };
  }
  if (type === "tear") {
    const requestedDepth = autoDimension(fallback?.depth, thickness * 2, "depth", mode, diagnostics);
    const requestedWidth = autoDimension(fallback?.width, Math.max(0.2, thickness * 0.05), "width", mode, diagnostics);
    const width = clampResolvedDimension(requestedWidth, "width", siteLimit(site, "corner", clearance), site, diagnostics);
    const depth = clampResolvedDimension(requestedDepth, "depth", siteLimit(site, "corner", clearance), site, diagnostics);
    return { ...base, status: resolvedStatus(base, diagnostics), width, depth };
  }
  if (type === "v-notch") {
    const requestedDepth = autoDimension(fallback?.depth, thickness * 2, "depth", mode, diagnostics);
    const requestedWidth = autoDimension(fallback?.width, thickness * 2, "width", mode, diagnostics);
    const width = clampResolvedDimension(requestedWidth, "width", siteLimit(site, "corner", clearance), site, diagnostics);
    const depth = clampResolvedDimension(requestedDepth, "depth", siteLimit(site, "corner", clearance), site, diagnostics);
    return { ...base, status: resolvedStatus(base, diagnostics), width, depth };
  }
  return {
    ...base,
    status: "unsupported",
    diagnostics: [{
      code: "corner-relief.type.unsupported",
      severity: "error",
      message: `Unsupported corner relief type ${String(fallback?.type || "")}.`
    }]
  };
}

export function defaultPlateCornerRelief(thickness = 0) {
  const defaultRadius = finiteNonNegativeNumber(thickness) ? thickness * 2 : 0;
  return {
    mode: "auto",
    type: "circular",
    radius: defaultRadius,
    gap: 0
  };
}

export function normalizePlateCornerReliefSpec(relief, label = "plate corner relief") {
  if (!plainObject(relief)) fail(`${label} must be an object`);
  if (!CORNER_RELIEF_MODES.has(relief.mode)) fail(`${label} mode must be auto or manual`);
  if (!CORNER_RELIEF_TYPES.has(relief.type)) fail(`${label} type is unsupported: ${relief.type}`);
  const type = canonicalPlateCornerReliefType(relief.type);
  const optionalDimension = (key) => {
    const value = relief[key];
    if (value === undefined) return undefined;
    if (!finiteNonNegativeNumber(value)) fail(`${label} ${key} must be zero or positive`);
    return value;
  };
  const radius = optionalDimension("radius");
  const width = optionalDimension("width");
  const depth = optionalDimension("depth");
  const gap = optionalDimension("gap");
  return {
    mode: relief.mode,
    type,
    ...(radius !== undefined ? { radius } : {}),
    ...(width !== undefined ? { width } : {}),
    ...(depth !== undefined ? { depth } : {}),
    ...(gap !== undefined ? { gap } : {})
  };
}

export function normalizePlateReliefDefaults(reliefDefaults) {
  if (reliefDefaults === undefined) return undefined;
  return normalizePlateCornerReliefSpec(reliefDefaults, "plate fabrication.reliefDefaults");
}

export function generatedBendCornerVertexId(parentBendId, parentEdge, bendId) {
  return `bend_corner_${parentBendId}_${parentEdge}_${bendId}`;
}

export function normalizePlateCornerReliefs(cornerReliefs, sketch, fabrication = {}) {
  if (cornerReliefs === undefined) return undefined;
  if (!Array.isArray(cornerReliefs)) fail("plate fabrication.cornerReliefs must be an array");
  const vertexIds = new Set([
    ...sketchVertices(sketch).map((vertex) => vertex.id),
    ...plateBendCorners({ sketch, fabrication }).map((corner) => corner.vertexId)
  ]);
  const reliefIds = new Set();
  const reliefVertexIds = new Set();
  return cornerReliefs.map((relief, index) => {
    const label = `plate fabrication.cornerReliefs[${index}]`;
    if (!plainObject(relief)) fail(`${label} must be an object`);
    if (typeof relief.id !== "string" || !relief.id.trim()) fail(`${label}.id must be a non-empty string`);
    if (reliefIds.has(relief.id)) fail(`duplicate corner relief id ${relief.id}`);
    reliefIds.add(relief.id);
    if (typeof relief.vertexId !== "string" || !relief.vertexId.trim()) fail(`${label}.vertexId must be a non-empty string`);
    if (!vertexIds.has(relief.vertexId)) fail(`${label}.vertexId references unknown sketch vertex ${relief.vertexId}`);
    if (reliefVertexIds.has(relief.vertexId)) fail(`duplicate corner relief vertex ${relief.vertexId}`);
    reliefVertexIds.add(relief.vertexId);
    return {
      id: relief.id,
      vertexId: relief.vertexId,
      ...normalizePlateCornerReliefSpec(relief, label)
    };
  });
}

export function plateBendCorners(plate) {
  const bends = plateBends(plate);
  const bendByEdge = new Map(
    bends
      .filter((bend) => !bend.parentBendId)
      .map((bend) => [bend.edgeId, bend])
  );
  const bendIds = new Set(bends.map((bend) => bend.id));
  const sketchCorners = orderedSketchLoop(plate?.sketch).flatMap((corner) => {
    const incomingBend = bendByEdge.get(corner.incomingEdgeId);
    const outgoingBend = bendByEdge.get(corner.outgoingEdgeId);
    if (!incomingBend || !outgoingBend) return [];
    return [{
      id: `corner_relief_${corner.vertexId}`,
      vertexId: corner.vertexId,
      siteKey: `sketch:${corner.vertexId}`,
      scope: "sketch",
      target: {
        kind: "sketchVertex",
        vertexId: corner.vertexId
      },
      incomingEdgeId: corner.incomingEdgeId,
      outgoingEdgeId: corner.outgoingEdgeId,
      incomingBendId: incomingBend.id,
      outgoingBendId: outgoingBend.id,
      point: corner.point
    }];
  });
  const childCorners = bends.flatMap((bend) => {
    if (!bend.parentBendId || !CHILD_CORNER_PARENT_EDGES.has(bend.parentEdge) || !bendIds.has(bend.parentBendId)) return [];
    const parentEndpoint = bend.parentEdge === "end" ? "end" : "start";
    const vertexId = generatedBendCornerVertexId(bend.parentBendId, bend.parentEdge, bend.id);
    const siteKey = `bend:${bend.parentBendId}:${bend.parentEdge}:${bend.id}:start`;
    return [{
      id: `corner_relief_${vertexId}`,
      vertexId,
      siteKey,
      scope: "bend",
      target: {
        kind: "bendEndpoint",
        parentBendId: bend.parentBendId,
        parentEdge: bend.parentEdge,
        bendId: bend.id,
        endpoint: "start",
        parentEndpoint
      },
      parentBendId: bend.parentBendId,
      parentEdge: bend.parentEdge,
      targetParentBendId: bend.parentBendId,
      targetParentEdge: bend.parentEdge,
      targetEndpoint: "start",
      incomingBendId: bend.parentBendId,
      outgoingBendId: bend.id
    }];
  });
  return [...sketchCorners, ...childCorners];
}

export function plateCornerReliefs(plate) {
  const corners = plateBendCorners(plate);
  const defaults = plate?.fabrication?.reliefDefaults || (corners.length ? defaultPlateCornerRelief(plate.thickness) : null);
  const overrides = new Map(arrayValues(plate?.fabrication?.cornerReliefs).map((relief) => [relief.vertexId, relief]));
  return corners.map((corner) => {
    const override = overrides.get(corner.vertexId) || null;
    const relief = override || defaults;
    const source = override ? "override" : relief ? "default" : "none";
    return {
      ...corner,
      id: override?.id || corner.id,
      source,
      relief: relief || null,
      resolvedRelief: relief ? resolvePlateCornerReliefSpec(relief, plate, { ...corner, source }) : null
    };
  });
}

export function cleanPlateCornerReliefFabrication(plate, fabrication) {
  const next = plainObject(fabrication) ? { ...fabrication } : {};
  const cornerVertexIds = new Set(plateBendCorners({ ...plate, fabrication: next }).map((corner) => corner.vertexId));
  if (!cornerVertexIds.size) {
    delete next.reliefDefaults;
    delete next.cornerReliefs;
    return next;
  }
  if (!next.reliefDefaults) next.reliefDefaults = defaultPlateCornerRelief(plate.thickness);
  if (Array.isArray(next.cornerReliefs)) {
    next.cornerReliefs = next.cornerReliefs.filter((relief) => cornerVertexIds.has(relief?.vertexId));
    if (!next.cornerReliefs.length) delete next.cornerReliefs;
  }
  return next;
}

FILE: bobercad/app/engine/api/project/plate-sketch/edge-geometry.mjs

import { clamp, finiteNumber } from "../../../core/math.mjs";

const EPSILON = 1e-9;
const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
const DEFAULT_CIRCLE_SEGMENTS = 32;
const QUADRANT_ANGLES = [0, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI, Math.PI * 1.5];

export const SKETCH_EDGE_LINE = "line";
export const SKETCH_EDGE_CIRCULAR_ARC = "circular-arc";

function edgeFail(message) {
  throw new Error(`plate sketch edge geometry: ${message}`);
}

function nonEmptyString(value) {
  return typeof value === "string" && value.trim();
}

function requiredPoint2(value, label, fail = edgeFail) {
  if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length !== 2 || value.some((item) => !finiteNumber(item))) {
    fail(`${label} must be a finite [y, z] point`);
  }
  return [...value];
}

function pointDistance2(a, b) {
  return Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]);
}

function angleOf(center, point) {
  return Math.atan2(point[1] - center[1], point[0] - center[0]);
}

function positiveAngle(angle) {
  const value = angle % TAU;
  return value < 0 ? value + TAU : value;
}

function arcSweep(startAngle, endAngle, direction) {
  if (direction === "ccw") return positiveAngle(endAngle - startAngle);
  return -positiveAngle(startAngle - endAngle);
}

function angleInsideRuntimeArc(runtime, angle) {
  const sweep = Math.abs(runtime.sweep);
  const distance = runtime.sweep >= 0
    ? positiveAngle(angle - runtime.startAngle)
    : positiveAngle(runtime.startAngle - angle);
  return distance > EPSILON && distance < sweep - EPSILON;
}

function finitePositive(value) {
  return finiteNumber(value) && value > EPSILON;
}

function sampleSegmentCount(runtime, options = {}) {
  if (finitePositive(options.segmentLength)) {
    return Math.max(2, Math.ceil(runtime.length / options.segmentLength));
  }
  const baseSegments = Number.isInteger(options.circleSegments) && options.circleSegments >= 4
    ? options.circleSegments
    : DEFAULT_CIRCLE_SEGMENTS;
  return Math.max(2, Math.ceil(baseSegments * Math.abs(runtime.sweep) / TAU));
}

function assertEndpointRadius(point, center, radius, label, fail) {
  const distance = pointDistance2(center, point);
  const tolerance = Math.max(1e-6, radius * 1e-6);
  if (Math.abs(distance - radius) > tolerance) {
    fail(`${label} must lie on circular-arc radius ${radius}`);
  }
}

function edgeEndpointPoints(edge, vertexMap, fail = edgeFail) {
  const a = vertexMap.get(edge.from);
  const b = vertexMap.get(edge.to);
  if (!a || !b) fail(`edge ${edge.id || ""} has missing vertices`);
  return { a, b };
}

export function sketchEdgeKind(edge) {
  if (!edge || typeof edge !== "object") return SKETCH_EDGE_LINE;
  if (edge.kind === undefined || edge.kind === SKETCH_EDGE_LINE) return SKETCH_EDGE_LINE;
  return edge.kind;
}

export function normalizeSketchEdge(edge, vertexMap, options = {}) {
  const fail = options.fail || edgeFail;
  if (!edge || typeof edge !== "object" || Array.isArray(edge)) fail("sketch edge must be an object");
  if (!nonEmptyString(edge.id)) fail("sketch edge id must be a non-empty string");
  if (!nonEmptyString(edge.from)) fail(`sketch edge ${edge.id} from must be a non-empty string`);
  if (!nonEmptyString(edge.to)) fail(`sketch edge ${edge.id} to must be a non-empty string`);
  if (edge.from === edge.to) fail(`sketch edge ${edge.id} must reference two distinct vertices`);
  edgeEndpointPoints(edge, vertexMap, fail);

  const kind = sketchEdgeKind(edge);
  if (kind === SKETCH_EDGE_LINE) {
    return edge.kind === undefined ? { ...edge } : { ...edge, kind };
  }

  if (kind !== SKETCH_EDGE_CIRCULAR_ARC) fail(`unsupported sketch edge kind: ${kind}`);
  const center = requiredPoint2(edge.center, `sketch edge ${edge.id} center`, fail);
  if (!finitePositive(edge.radius)) fail(`sketch edge ${edge.id} radius must be positive`);
  if (edge.direction !== "cw" && edge.direction !== "ccw") {
    fail(`sketch edge ${edge.id} direction must be cw or ccw`);
  }
  const runtime = sketchEdgeRuntime({ ...edge, kind, center }, vertexMap, { fail });
  if (Math.abs(runtime.sweep) <= EPSILON) fail(`sketch edge ${edge.id} circular-arc sweep cannot be zero`);
  return {
    ...edge,
    kind,
    center,
    radius: edge.radius,
    direction: edge.direction
  };
}

export function sketchEdgeRuntime(edge, vertexMap, options = {}) {
  const fail = options.fail || edgeFail;
  const { a, b } = edgeEndpointPoints(edge, vertexMap, fail);
  const kind = sketchEdgeKind(edge);
  if (kind === SKETCH_EDGE_LINE) {
    const length = pointDistance2(a, b);
    if (length <= EPSILON) fail(`sketch edge ${edge.id || ""} has zero length`);
    return {
      id: edge.id,
      kind,
      a,
      b,
      length,
      pointAt: (t) => [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t],
      tangentAt: () => [(b[0] - a[0]) / length, (b[1] - a[1]) / length]
    };
  }
  if (kind !== SKETCH_EDGE_CIRCULAR_ARC) fail(`unsupported sketch edge kind: ${kind}`);
  const center = requiredPoint2(edge.center, `sketch edge ${edge.id || ""} center`, fail);
  const radius = edge.radius;
  if (!finitePositive(radius)) fail(`sketch edge ${edge.id || ""} radius must be positive`);
  const direction = edge.direction;
  if (direction !== "cw" && direction !== "ccw") fail(`sketch edge ${edge.id || ""} direction must be cw or ccw`);
  assertEndpointRadius(a, center, radius, `sketch edge ${edge.id || ""} start`, fail);
  assertEndpointRadius(b, center, radius, `sketch edge ${edge.id || ""} end`, fail);
  const startAngle = angleOf(center, a);
  const endAngle = angleOf(center, b);
  const sweep = arcSweep(startAngle, endAngle, direction);
  if (Math.abs(sweep) <= EPSILON) fail(`sketch edge ${edge.id || ""} circular-arc sweep cannot be zero`);
  const directionSign = Math.sign(sweep);
  return {
    id: edge.id,
    kind,
    a,
    b,
    center,
    radius,
    direction,
    startAngle,
    endAngle,
    sweep,
    length: Math.abs(sweep) * radius,
    pointAt: (t) => {
      const angle = startAngle + sweep * clamp(t, 0, 1);
      return [center[0] + Math.cos(angle) * radius, center[1] + Math.sin(angle) * radius];
    },
    tangentAt: (t) => {
      const angle = startAngle + sweep * clamp(t, 0, 1);
      return [-Math.sin(angle) * directionSign, Math.cos(angle) * directionSign];
    }
  };
}

export function sketchEdgeLength(edge, vertexMap, options = {}) {
  return sketchEdgeRuntime(edge, vertexMap, options).length;
}

export function sketchEdgePointAt(edge, vertexMap, t = 0.5, options = {}) {
  return sketchEdgeRuntime(edge, vertexMap, options).pointAt(clamp(t, 0, 1));
}

export function sketchEdgeCenterPoint(edge, vertexMap, options = {}) {
  const runtime = sketchEdgeRuntime(edge, vertexMap, options);
  return runtime.kind === SKETCH_EDGE_CIRCULAR_ARC ? [...runtime.center] : null;
}

export function sketchEdgeQuadrantPoints(edge, vertexMap, options = {}) {
  const runtime = sketchEdgeRuntime(edge, vertexMap, options);
  if (runtime.kind !== SKETCH_EDGE_CIRCULAR_ARC) return [];
  return QUADRANT_ANGLES
    .filter((angle) => angleInsideRuntimeArc(runtime, angle))
    .map((angle) => ({
      angle,
      point: [
        runtime.center[0] + Math.cos(angle) * runtime.radius,
        runtime.center[1] + Math.sin(angle) * runtime.radius
      ]
    }));
}

export function sampleSketchEdge(edge, vertexMap, options = {}) {
  const runtime = sketchEdgeRuntime(edge, vertexMap, options);
  if (runtime.kind === SKETCH_EDGE_LINE) return [[...runtime.a], [...runtime.b]];
  const segmentCount = sampleSegmentCount(runtime, options);
  const points = [];
  for (let index = 0; index <= segmentCount; index += 1) {
    points.push(runtime.pointAt(index / segmentCount));
  }
  return points;
}

import { finitePositiveNumber } from "../../../core/math.mjs";
import { addIndexedObject, nextObjectId } from "../objects.mjs";
import { plateBends } from "./model-accessors.mjs";
import { normalizeBend } from "./bend-normalization.mjs";
import { normalizePlateCornerReliefs, normalizePlateReliefDefaults, plateBendCorners } from "./corner-reliefs.mjs";
import {
  cleanOutline,
  fail,
  normalizeSketch,
  normalized,
  optionalObject,
  optionalString,
  outlineFromSketch,
  sketchSource,
  vec3
} from "./sketch-geometry-and-relations.mjs";

export function normalizeSketchPlacement(object, fallbackId) {
  const label = object.id || fallbackId;
  return {
    ...object,
    center: vec3(object.center, `${label}.center`),
    normal: normalized(vec3(object.normal, `${label}.normal`), `${label}.normal`),
    localAxisY: normalized(vec3(object.localAxisY, `${label}.localAxisY`), `${label}.localAxisY`),
    localAxisZ: normalized(vec3(object.localAxisZ, `${label}.localAxisZ`), `${label}.localAxisZ`)
  };
}

export function normalizeSketchObject(sketchObject) {
  if (!sketchObject || typeof sketchObject !== "object") fail("sketch object must be an object");
  if (sketchObject.type !== "plate-sketch") fail(`${sketchObject.id || "sketch"} type must be plate-sketch`);
  const sketch = normalizeSketch(sketchObject.sketch);
  outlineFromSketch(sketch);
  return normalizeSketchPlacement({
    ...sketchObject,
    sketch
  }, "sketch");
}


export function normalizePlate(plate) {
  if (!plate || typeof plate !== "object") fail("plate must be an object");
  const sketch = normalizeSketch(plate.sketch);
  outlineFromSketch(sketch);
  const next = normalizeSketchPlacement({
    ...plate,
    sketch
  }, "plate");
  if (!finitePositiveNumber(next.thickness)) fail(`${next.id || "plate"} thickness must be positive`);
  if (next.fabrication !== undefined) {
    const fabrication = optionalObject(next.fabrication, {}, `${next.id || "plate"}.fabrication`);
    next.fabrication = {
      ...fabrication,
      ...(fabrication.reliefDefaults !== undefined ? { reliefDefaults: normalizePlateReliefDefaults(fabrication.reliefDefaults) } : {}),
      ...(fabrication.cornerReliefs !== undefined ? { cornerReliefs: normalizePlateCornerReliefs(fabrication.cornerReliefs, sketch, fabrication) } : {})
    };
  }
  const bends = plateBends(next);
  if (Array.isArray(next.fabrication?.bends)) {
    const bendIds = new Set();
    for (const bend of bends) {
      if (typeof bend?.id !== "string" || !bend.id.trim()) fail("bend id must be a non-empty string");
      if (bendIds.has(bend.id)) fail(`duplicate bend id ${bend.id}`);
      bendIds.add(bend.id);
    }
    next.fabrication = {
      ...next.fabrication,
      bends: bends.map((bend) => normalizeBend(bend, sketch, bendIds))
    };
  }
  if (Array.isArray(next.fabrication?.cornerReliefs)) {
    const cornerVertexIds = new Set(plateBendCorners(next).map((corner) => corner.vertexId));
    for (const relief of next.fabrication.cornerReliefs) {
      if (!cornerVertexIds.has(relief.vertexId)) fail(`${relief.id}: corner relief vertex ${relief.vertexId} is not shared by adjacent bends`);
    }
  }
  return next;
}

function createPlateObject(project, options = {}) {
  const id = nextObjectId(project, options.id === undefined ? "plate" : options.id);
  return normalizePlate({
    ...options,
    id,
    type: optionalString(options.type, "plate", "plate type"),
    sketch: options.sketch
  });
}

export function addPlate(project, options = {}) {
  const plate = createPlateObject(project, options);
  addIndexedObject(project, "plates", plate);
  return plate;
}

export function addSketch(project, options = {}) {
  const id = nextObjectId(project, options.id === undefined ? "sketch" : options.id);
  const sketch = sketchSource(options, id, "addSketch");
  const sketchObject = normalizeSketchObject({
    ...options,
    id,
    type: optionalString(options.type, "plate-sketch", "sketch type"),
    sketch
  });
  addIndexedObject(project, "sketches", sketchObject);
  return sketchObject;
}

export function plateFromSketchObject(project, sketchObject, options = {}) {
  const source = normalizeSketchObject(sketchObject);
  const placementIntent = optionalObject(options.placementIntent, {}, "plate placementIntent");
  return createPlateObject(project, {
    ...options,
    id: options.id === undefined ? `${source.id}_plate` : options.id,
    type: optionalString(options.type, "plate", "plate type"),
    sketch: source.sketch,
    center: source.center,
    normal: source.normal,
    localAxisY: source.localAxisY,
    localAxisZ: source.localAxisZ,
    thickness: options.thickness,
    material: options.material || "S355",
    placementIntent: {
      ...placementIntent,
      role: optionalString(placementIntent.role, "plate-from-sketch", "plate placementIntent.role"),
      sourceSketchId: source.id
    }
  });
}

export function profileFromSectionSketch({ id, designation, outline, material = "S355" }) {
  const points = cleanOutline(outline);
  return {
    id,
    designation: designation || id,
    profileType: "custom-section",
    section: {
      type: "polygonal-section",
      origin: "center",
      contours: [{ id: "outer", role: "solid", points }]
    },
    properties: { material }
  };
}
